title.purpose: Names the exhibition on the viewer plate.

body.purpose: Sets explanatory text and field values.

motion.name: busy-spin
motion.purpose: Rotates the busy indicator during publishing. Reduced motion disables the animation.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Filled olive action for creating or publishing an exhibition.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-primary">Publish gallery <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14m-7-7 7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 46px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; background: var(--olive, #545c42); color: #fffdf9; font: 600 13px/1.55 var(--sans, 'DM Sans', sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #414934; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #69572b; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: default; }

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Outlined action for launching the private preview.
components.css: .ds-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 46px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid #a99d89; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #2d2921); font: 600 13px/1.55 var(--sans, 'DM Sans', sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-secondary:hover { background: #eeeadf; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #69572b; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: default; }

components.name: Exhibition title
components.description: Labeled native field with a paper-toned fill.
components.css: .ds-title-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; width: min(440px, 100%); color: var(--soft, #655d50); font: 400 13px/1.55 var(--sans, 'DM Sans', sans-serif); } .ds-title-field input { min-width: 0; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #bcb09f; border-radius: 0; background: #faf6ee; color: var(--ink, #2d2921); font: 400 15px/1.55 var(--sans, 'DM Sans', sans-serif); } .ds-title-field input::placeholder { color: #716858; } .ds-title-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #69572b; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Upload area
components.description: Dashed photograph drop target with an underlined file picker action.
components.html:
Drop your photographs hereor from your device
JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF
components.css: .ds-upload { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 122px; padding: 20px 24px; border: 1px dashed #9f9384; background: #f8f4ec; color: var(--ink, #2d2921); font: 400 15px/1.55 var(--sans, 'DM Sans', sans-serif); } .ds-upload:hover, .ds-upload:focus-within, .ds-upload.ds-dragging { border-color: var(--olive, #545c42); background: #eee9dc; } .ds-upload > svg { flex: none; color: var(--olive, #545c42); } .ds-upload div { display: grid; gap: 3px; } .ds-upload strong { font-weight: 600; } .ds-upload span, .ds-upload small { color: var(--soft, #655d50); font-size: 13px; } .ds-upload small { margin-left: auto; } .ds-upload button { border: 0; background: none; padding: 0; color: var(--olive, #545c42); font: inherit; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-upload button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #69572b; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 490px) { .ds-upload { flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 16px; } .ds-upload small { width: 100%; margin: -4px 0 0 40px; } }

components.name: Viewer actions
components.description: Parchment plate grouping the photograph index and share actions.
components.css: .ds-viewer-actions { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 3px; background: var(--paper, #f6f1e8); border: 1px solid #c3b6a2; color: var(--ink, #2d2921); } .ds-viewer-actions button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; background: none; color: inherit; white-space: nowrap; font: 600 12px/1.55 var(--sans, 'DM Sans', sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-viewer-actions button + button { border-left: 1px solid var(--rule, #d7cec0); } .ds-viewer-actions button:hover { background: #eae2d5; } .ds-viewer-actions button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #69572b; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 790px) { .ds-viewer-actions button { padding: 0 6px; gap: 4px; font-size: 11px; } .ds-viewer-actions svg { width: 14px; } }

components.name: Room selection
components.description: Numbered navigation with an olive current location.
components.html: <nav class="ds-room-navigation" aria-label="Gallery rooms"><button type="button" aria-label="Go to room 1" aria-current="location">1</button><button type="button" aria-label="Go to room 2">2</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-room-navigation { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid #c3b6a2; background: var(--paper, #f6f1e8); color: var(--ink, #2d2921); font: 400 12px/1.55 var(--sans, 'DM Sans', sans-serif); } .ds-room-navigation button { min-width: 34px; min-height: 34px; padding: 5px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-room-navigation [aria-current] { background: var(--olive, #545c42); color: white; } .ds-room-navigation button:hover:not([aria-current]) { background: #eae2d5; } .ds-room-navigation button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #69572b; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Photograph index
components.description: Parchment index with an aligned thumbnail, order number, and photograph title.
components.html:
The photographs

Select a photograph for a closer look.
components.css: .ds-photo-index { box-sizing: border-box; width: min(435px, 100%); padding: 68px 24px 24px; background: var(--paper, #f6f1e8); color: var(--ink, #2d2921); } .ds-photo-index h2 { margin: 0; font: 400 38px/1 var(--serif, 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif); } .ds-photo-index p { margin: 11px 0 19px; color: var(--soft, #655d50); font: 400 13px/1.55 var(--sans, 'DM Sans', sans-serif); } .ds-photo-index button { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 54px 22px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 10px; align-items: center; width: 100%; padding: 10px 0; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #d7cec0); background: none; color: inherit; text-align: left; font: 400 13px/1.55 var(--sans, 'DM Sans', sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-photo-index button:hover { background: #e9e3d8; } .ds-photo-index button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #69572b; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-index-thumbnail { display: block; width: 54px; height: 45px; background: var(--rule, #d7cec0); } .ds-index-number { color: var(--soft, #655d50); font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-photo-index b { font: inherit; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

narrative.overview: The gallery opens beside a glazed olive courtyard with flat limestone planes and a warm oak floor, then leads through offset passages to a darker print wing with smoked oak and a flat timber ceiling. The interface borrows the proportions and typography of museum labels.
keyCharacteristics: Make photographs the focal points along the walk. Frame each in a slim dark wood surround with a cream mat and a small label below.
Let the room occupy the full viewport. Put exhibition information, actions, and movement controls in compact panels around its edges.
Use Cormorant Garamond for exhibition titles and headings, and DM Sans for instructions, captions, and controls.
